name: CN_TP_PARTICIPANT_CNTS_ALL
description: This table stores the number of transactions, credits, earnings and measures for a participant in a specific period.

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_CNT_ID
columns.description: Generated from sequence.

columns.name: SIMULATION_ID
columns.description: When executing for a calculation simulation, identifies the simulation associated to the row.

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for salesrep.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: PERIOD_ID
columns.description: Period identifier.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Period start date.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Period end date.

columns.name: TXN_CNT
columns.description: Number of transactions for participant in period.

columns.name: CREDIT_CNT
columns.description: Number of credits for participant in period.

columns.name: MSR_CNT
columns.description: Number of measures for participant in period.

columns.name: EARNING_CNT
columns.description: Number of earnings for participant in period.

columns.name: PMT_TXN_CNT
columns.description: Number of payment transaction records of the participant as per the paybatch pay period.

columns.name: EARNING_REVERSALS_CNT
columns.description: Number of earning reversals for participant in period.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
